## Discussion, limitations and open questions

Within the family with two bound states, the bound $e^{-2\Delta}$ holds for 50 of 88 topologies and fails for fam2_66, fam2_9 and fam2_11. It is therefore not satisfied by every member [C-fakt-klassifikation]. For the chain with $n=2$, the corresponding bound $e^{-3\Delta}$ is proved for all rates [C-proofreading-R9].

**Limitations.** All results are for $\Delta=\ln 100$ [C-modell]. The counterexamples are existence statements with rates in $[e^{-10},e^{10}]$ and rational rounding [C-modell]. The $\sigma$ and $v$ values of the counterexample are those given in Table 2 [C-fakt-fam66]. Thirty-five topologies remain open [C-fakt-klassifikation]. Of the ten topologies in the reachability proposition, only fam2_9 and fam2_11 are classified as counterexamples [C-proofreading-O14, C-fakt-klassifikation].

**Open questions.**

(i) Which of the open topologies obey $\eta \ge e^{-2\Delta}$, and which can break it [C-fakt-klassifikation]?

(ii) Do the remaining topologies of the reachability proposition admit $\eta < e^{-2\Delta}$ strictly [C-proofreading-O14, C-fakt-klassifikation]?

(iii) Does $\eta \ge e^{-(n+1)\Delta}$ hold for chains with $n$ other than 2? Only $n=2$ is proved here [C-proofreading-R9, C-proofreading-R3].

(iv) What structural feature of fam2_66, fam2_9 and fam2_11 explains the violation [C-fakt-klassifikation]?

## Appendix A: Agentic laboratory

**Workflow.** The laboratory ran 16 rounds, yielding 14 verified statements and 2 negative results [C-methode]. Every round was preregistered before the experiment [C-methode]. Preregistration H6 (commit 6184672) preceded the first run, and addenda are dated [C-fakt-praereg]. The L2c success criterion (at least 5 counterexamples in a round) was not met: 2 were found in round 12, and 3 in total [C-fakt-praereg].

**Agents and roles.** The attempts recorded in the negative results involved the roles sparsam, numeriker, skeptiker and theoretiker, run on the haiku and sonnet models, as well as a researcher role [C-neg1, C-neg2].

**Literature search.** In total, 2752 sources were retrieved (arXiv, Europe PMC, Crossref, citation chain) and 2502 were screened. For 158 findings, a verbatim quote in the abstract was confirmed by code [C-fakt-recherche]. All 11 classic-paper searches produced a hit [C-fakt-recherche].

**Red team.** There were 29 counter-checks in total: 5 passed, 12 did not pass, and 12 could not be executed [C-redteam]. Selected outcomes:

- The parameters of the first example, with $\eta$ = 3.650169e-04, $\sigma$ in [6.000000, 6.000000] $kT$ and $v$ = 1.0417e-01, remain admissible at a larger dissipation budget [C-proofreading-R1-RT1]. The reported jump of the front is therefore impossible, and the reported kink is an optimizer artifact [C-proofreading-R1-RT1].
- A symbolic attempt to prove a lower bound for hopfield_n1 failed, as expected [C-proofreading-R8-RT1].
- An independent verifier search for $n=2$ (24 starts, seed 4711) found eta_min = 3.1387e-05 at sigma = 2665.585, v = 2.037e-06 [C-proofreading-R9-RT2]. It did not confirm the claimed value 1.0000e-07 [C-proofreading-R9-RT2].
- Symbolic proofs of $\eta \ge 1/D^2$ failed for the members fam2_9, fam2_11 and fam2_13 (0 of 3 proved) and for 0 of 8 further members, consistent with their open status [C-proofreading-R12-RT1, C-proofreading-O14-RT1].

**Additional certified statement (appendix only).** For hopfield_n1 there exist rational rates in $[e^{-10},e^{10}]$ satisfying local detailed balance with $\eta \le 0.0004$, $\sigma \le 8\,kT$ per product and $v \ge 0.001$ [C-proofreading-R2]. The certificates (a) are $\eta$ = 3.156120e-04, $\sigma$ in [6.000000, 6.000000] $kT$, $v$ = 2.4255e-02; and $\eta$ = 2.043712e-04, $\sigma$ in [3.079633, 3.079633] $kT$, $v$ = 2.2592e-03 [C-proofreading-R2]. For 3 topologies, $\eta \ge 1/D^2$ was also proved symbolically in a separate run [C-proofreading-R7].

**Negative results in detail.**

- *Question: is a fuel-driven discard exit at the product state necessary to go below the two-bound-state bound?* No claim passed the verifier. All four attempts (roles sparsam, numeriker, skeptiker, theoretiker; schranke_familie) failed because of a verifier defect, which was later fixed [C-neg1].
- *Question: do further open topologies reach $\eta \le e^{-2\Delta}$?* Certificate (a) passed in 10 of 11 cases [C-neg2]. The case fam2_13 failed because a rate lay outside the allowed range $[e^{-10},e^{10}]$ (derived reverse rates included) [C-neg2, C-modell].
